description: Create a draft weekly or monthly tracker: one measurement — rankings, compare, citations, or sentiment applied to a list of prompts, with the brand, competitors and AI surfaces set once for all of them, or keyword_rankings applied to a list of keywords for one domain, country and device. Prompt lists can come from cite42_map_ai_prompts research. Creation does not start recurring calls. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates, or one check per keyword for keyword_rankings.

brand.description: Required for compare and sentiment. Not used by rankings or citations.

monthday.description: Monthly trackers only. Day of month 1-31; a value past the end of a shorter month runs on that month's last day, so 31 always means "month end".

time.description: Local run time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/London or America/New_York.

weekday.description: Weekly trackers only. Day of week, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday.

competitors.description: Required for rankings (the brands to track, including your own) and compare (the rivals to rank against, up to 10). Not used by citations or sentiment.

country.description: ISO-2 country. keyword_rankings: the Google market, defaults to "us". AI measurements: optional country to measure from; omit for each surface's default. On an update of an AI tracker, omitting it keeps the stored market and null removes it.

device.description: keyword_rankings only: desktop or mobile results. Defaults to desktop.

domain.description: keyword_rankings only: the site to find in Google results, e.g. example.com.

keyword.description: A search term as people type it into Google.

page.description: Optional page on the site that should rank for it: a full URL or a path such as /pricing.

keywords.description: keyword_rankings only: up to 100 keywords, each with an optional target page. Each keyword is billed as its own check on every run.

language.description: ISO-2 language, defaulting to the country's main language. AI measurements use it only for google_ai_overview and chatgpt_app, and need a country with it.

models.description: AI surfaces to query for every prompt. Omit for the three defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini), or list surfaces explicitly to set the recurring cost; chatgpt_app (the ChatGPT app itself) is opt-in. There is no fullSweep here: a saved tracker stores the exact list it was authorized for. Not used by keyword_rankings.

primitive.description: What to measure: rankings (which brands get named), compare (the brand against named competitors), citations (which sources are cited) or sentiment (how one brand is described) run across AI surfaces for every prompt; keyword_rankings checks Google positions of a domain for every keyword. One measurement per tracker.

items.description: A prompt to run on every scheduled run.

prompts.description: AI measurements: the prompts to track, up to 30. Each is billed as its own call on every run. Keep the wording stable so runs stay comparable, avoid dates, and do not repeat a prompt. Not used by keyword_rankings.

url.description: Citations only: a URL to report on as cited or not cited.

name: cite42_tracker_create
